mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT P.ORG_IDENTITY FROM PARTY_ORGANIZATION P WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(P.ORG_IDENTITY)) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DYN_ZHUXINGJ M WHERE M.PARTY_ID = P.ID) ORDER BY P.ORG_IDENTITY
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(TRIM(BDBH), 1, 4) AS BUSINESS_YEAR FROM DYN_ZHUXINGJ WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(BDBH)) >= 4 ORDER BY BUSINESS_YEAR DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DYN_ZHUXINGJ M LEFT JOIN PARTY_ORGANIZATION P ON P.ID = M.PARTY_ID WHERE

SELECT ID FROM ( SELECT M.ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY P.TREE_SORTS, P.TREE_SORT, P.ID, M.BDBH, M.ID) AS RN FROM DYN_ZHUXINGJ M LEFT JOIN PARTY_ORGANIZATION P ON P.ID = M.PARTY_ID WHERE ) WHERE RN > #{offset} AND RN <= #{limit} ORDER BY RN
SELECT M.ID FROM DYN_ZHUXINGJ M JOIN PARTY_ORGANIZATION P ON P.ID = M.PARTY_ID WHERE P.ORG_IDENTITY = #{orgIdentity} ORDER BY M.ID
SELECT ID, WJ, JTXM, JTNR, TO_CHAR(SJJD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PLANNED_DATE, XH, KHSFKF FROM DYN_ZXGJZB WHERE WJ IN #{id} ORDER BY ID FOR UPDATE
SELECT ID, PARTY_NAME, ORG_IDENTITY, ATTRIBUTE_02, ATTRIBUTE_03 FROM PARTY_ORGANIZATION WHERE ID IN #{id} ORDER BY ID
SELECT PARENT_REGISTER_ID, COUNT(*) AS ATTACHMENT_COUNT FROM SYS_ATTACHMENT WHERE PARENT_REGISTER_ID IN #{id} GROUP BY PARENT_REGISTER_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE DYN_ZXGJZB SET KHSFKF = '是' WHERE ID = #{id} AND (KHSFKF IS NULL OR KHSFKF <> '是')
UPDATE DYN_ZHUXINGJ SET NDZJKF = '是' WHERE ID = #{id} AND (NDZJKF IS NULL OR NDZJKF <> '是')
